HEALTH CAN’T WAIT.

Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t.

Alan exists to end the wait.

Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way.

So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience.

We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture https://alan.com/en/careers. We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR.

Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 800+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond.

EUROPE’S FASTEST-GROWING ONE-STOP HEALTH PARTNER IS EXPANDING TO ARMENIA. JOIN THE TEAM AS ONE OF THE FIRST EMPLOYEES IN ARMENIA AND BUILD THE FUTURE OF HEALTH.

🐼 WHO WE ARE

Alan https://alan.com/ is Europe's fastest-growing one-stop health partner, on track to become a global healthcare giant by 2030.

We empower 1m+ members across 35,000+ companies, generating €800m+ in annual recurring revenue and growing +50% last year. Our latest round valued Alan at €5bn, with world-class investors (e.g., Index Ventures, Temasek, Coatue, OTPP, Ribbit).

Our vision: make prevention the new norm of care for all.

Our mission: help people live in good health to 100 while helping employers feel proud, turning health benefits from a cost centre into their most valuable investment.

Our approach: build the vertically integrated payor and provider, uniting full-stack insurance and smart healthcare delivery into one seamless system. We are the ultimate one-stop health partner for people and companies.

Our team of around 700 people (still growing) operates across France 🇫🇷, Spain 🇪🇸, Belgium 🇧🇪, Canada 🇨🇦. And now, we’re expanding in Armenia 🇦🇲.

🤘 HOW WE DO IT ?

People joining Alan are often surprised and delighted by our innovative working method. We have a set of cultural values https://alan.com/about/company-culture that guide our approach to work, such as:

🎯 What drives us — We're obsessed with helping our members live healthier

Mission is the Boss: long-term thinking, seeking our mission success above all else.

Member & customer-led: obsessively focused on solving members & customers problems and creating the most delightful experiences.

🏆 How we build excellence — We hire the best people and give them platform to succeed

Champions of excellence: extremely high standards and talent density.

Distributed ownership: accountable enlightened despots, everyone owns their decisions and results.

Radically transparent: all information is accessible and written-first, so everyone can make the best decisions asynchronously

🤝 How we grow together — We help each other improve through honest feedback and bold thinking

Optimistic alchemy: optimists who collaborate with genuine care and support teammates.

Empathetic challengers: direct, caring feedback combined with praises to help each other grow professionally

Bold & creative contrarians: think differently to achieve greatness, try new approaches

⚡ How we move fast — We fight complexity and focus on what matters most

Disciplined in execution: taking decisive actions with focus that compounds success over time

Fight for simplicity: only high impact processes, smart frugality

⭐️ THE SENIOR ENGINEERING MANAGER JOB AT ALAN

At Alan, our engineering leaders are exceptional technical leaders who combine strategic vision with hands-on leadership to drive both team excellence and technical innovation. They are deeply involved in the strategic, technical and product direction of the team, as well as the human aspects of building high-performing engineering teams.

🚀 YOUR MISSION

As a Senior Engineering Manager at Alan, you'll be responsible for leading one of our engineering departments, comprising 6-15 engineers and organised in autonomous and nimble teams. You'll shape the technical vision, foster a culture of innovation, continuous learning, and ensure your teams deliver impactful solutions while maintaining engineering excellence.

In this role, you will:

- Set and communicate a clear vision for why and what we're building, establishing high expectations and identifying key assets and opportunities.

- Bring daily energy to the team, providing context and fostering mutual help to create a motivated and engaged team.

- Own the engineering efficiency and excellence of your team by using productivity tools (including AI), zooming in and out depending on the needs of the team.

- Challenge what's "good enough" to build and ship, while removing sources of unnecessary defocus.

- Monitor team well-being and ensure psychological safety to maintain a healthy team dynamic.

- Own talent density by hiring exceptional talent, supporting team members' growth and addressing performance concerns promptly.

- Collaborate daily with stakeholders, product managers, designers, other engineering leads, etc.

This is the perfect role for you if you have exceptional people management skills, a great technical background and if you are passionate about building both great products and great teams. A minimum of 3 to 5 years of experience in engineering management is required.
